title: {{NAME}} and the Glittery Robot Garden
moral: Taking care of something beautiful is a gift to everyone.

pages.content: {{NAME}} found a magical garden one morning. The garden was full of silver flowers and rainbow trees. A friendly orange dinosaur was digging in the mud. A small yellow robot was watering the plants. But the garden's most special flower had lost all its sparkle. It was grey and drooping. Something had to be done.

pages.content: The yellow robot said her name was Zara. Zara was very sad about the flower. "Only unicorn magic can fix it," said Zara. {{NAME}} looked around the garden. Then he heard a soft whinny from the trees. A white unicorn stepped out slowly. She had a silver horn and a blue mane. {{NAME}}'s eyes lit up with hope.

pages.content: The unicorn touched her silver horn to the drooping flower. The flower glowed pink and gold. It grew taller and taller. Sparks flew into the air. The whole garden lit up bright. {{NAME}} clapped his hands. The orange dinosaur stomped with joy. Zara spun around and around in happy circles.

pages.content: The garden was beautiful again. Every flower glowed and sparkled. {{NAME}} and Zara worked together to plant new seeds. The orange dinosaur used his big tail to dig neat rows. The unicorn walked slowly between the rows, making each seed glow. Taking care of something beautiful is a gift to everyone.

pages.content: As the stars came out, the garden glowed softly. {{NAME}} sat on warm grass with all his friends. The flowers hummed a quiet tune. The unicorn rested her head on {{NAME}}'s lap. Taking care of something beautiful is a gift to everyone. {{NAME}} felt so cosy and sleepy. He wondered if there were more magic gardens hidden in the world.
